replaces.reference: sherlock-k-a/1 physical Tree representation: one allocation per tree child occurrence in program literals and runtime boundary states (leaf/branch constructors allocate fresh nodes)

candidate.by: hash-consed allocation per structurally distinct node (TreeInterner), applied to program literals and re-applied to every boundary state before Machine::from_snapshot resumes
candidate.realization: sherlock-k-a/1 host reference machine of the dedicated draft source (mori simulate --optimization; --reference-slices then resumes cuts from interned snapshots). The B helper-microstep owner execution and its images are NOT changed by this candidate.

preservation_predicate.statement: For the same program, fuel and stack limit, the candidate run has the same event count and per-event rule order, the same per-event charge and before/after remaining fuel, depth and stack limit, structurally equal complete before/after boundary states (code, control, environment, frames), the same outcome class (Done/Rejected(code)/Exhausted) and the same returned value. Physical node identity is not an observation; structural equality is.
preservation_predicate.first_divergence: returns the clause, event index and detail of the first difference; mori simulate --optimization fails rather than reports on any divergence

clauses.statement: final Done value and every Value in each boundary state are structurally equal
outcome class and error code equal, including fuel exhaustion and K-A frame-cap Rejected(4); B exact/short/partial fuel and stack-1 outcomes equal on the sealed specimens
same event count and rule_start_line sequence (K-A --reference-slices 1 stream equal); no effects exist in this profile
every before/after step boundary and the initial and final states are complete-state equal; resumed boundaries are the interned states; technical-cut slices equal
ordered effects and residual duties equal: absent from sherlock-k-a/1 state (check_preservation reports duties_vacuous) and B tasks equal on the sealed specimens
per-event charge, remaining fuel, initial fuel, logical depth and stack limit equal at every boundary

costs.note: K-A events/work/remaining fuel equal per run; B consumed_work unchanged
peak structural tree child occurrences equal (logical counter of the replay)

costs.reference: 7 entry-literal nodes (R1); 6 peak child allocations on fold(branch(branch(leaf 1, leaf 2), branch(leaf 1, leaf 2)))

evidence.statement: evaluator-sealed specimens replayed under reference and --optimization: value, summary, tasks, --reference-slices 1 stream, exact/short/partial fuel and stack-1 outcomes, applied and physical reduction

unresolved_gaps.statement: Only a handful of fold/fact programs and budgets are run; other programs, list values and other error codes are not exercised. No proof that interning preserves equality for all states.
Effectful/financial profiles (Core/2 typed await, sherlock-helper-microstep/2 finance) are not covered; preservation of ordered effects and residual duties is unexamined there.

Only sherlock-k-a/1 step and technical-cut boundaries are realized by the candidate. B helper-microstep chunk/A4 boundaries, bounded C6 images (data arena append-only, child-before-parent) and canonical encode/decode are not interned; interning there would change active lengths and capacity checks.
B data/env capacity exhaustion under sharing is unexamined because the B owner is not realized by the candidate.
Only allocation counts are measured; byte sizes, host wall time and peak memory of reference vs candidate are not measured.
No circuit, native export or target realization of the candidate exists; rows, degree, key/proof sizes and DUST fees are unmeasured.
